# Plain Metal's generateMipmapsForTexture: on an Apple M3 Max (macOS 26.7, 25G229): strips and
# chains of the formats whose passes are fit (8-bit unorm, 32-bit float), from 66x1 to 16384x1 and
# 8192x64, Private, Shared and Private with allowGPUOptimizedContents off (share-mips-m3b, our own
# probe). The first levels come from measured_m3_passes.txt's probe, keyed by the chain's key; the
# Private 2048x16 chain ran twice, byte-identical. Each level's digest is the first 12 hex digits of
# the SHA-256 of its bytes, every layer in turn, rows tight.
# Format:
#   <key> <format> <2d|2darray|cube> <width>x<height> <layers> <pattern> <private|shared|plain>
#   <digest of level 0> ...
